command.openEndpoint: Go To Endpoint: Open Endpoint Definition
view.explorer.name: Endpoint Explorer
config.title: Go To Endpoints
config.includeGlobs: Glob patterns for files to include in the endpoint index.
config.excludeGlobs: Glob patterns for files or folders to exclude from the endpoint index.
config.enableCache: Enable caching to speed up indexing (no need to rescan unchanged files after restart).
config.concurrencyLimit: Limit the number of concurrent file parsing operations (higher values speed up indexing but increase memory usage).
config.autoIndex: Whether to automatically index all files when the extension starts.
config.usePrefilter: Whether to pre-filter files that don't contain controller annotations before parsing (improves speed).
config.enableDecorations: Whether to enable line decorations for API endpoints (highlighting and hover hints).
config.enableCodeLens: Whether to enable copy buttons (CodeLens) for API endpoints.
config.notificationTimeout: Auto-close timeout for notification messages in milliseconds (default 3000ms/3 seconds).
config.displayLanguage: Language for runtime UI (notifications, progress, CodeLens, status bar, quick pick). Command titles and settings descriptions still follow the VS Code display language when a language pack is installed.
